notes.title: Chapter 4: DevLog#3
notes.content:
Good day to you, Rebels!

Let me share with you the progress I have made, and what's to come for Chapter 4.

Although I still think I'm behind schedule, I'm beginning to see the end of the tunnel.

Here are the things I still must do:
- Complete the writing of the last couple of scenes
- Order the last couple of artworks
- Decide if I should include additional scenes (there are a couple of characters that don't appear at all so far in Chapter 4, maybe it would be good to have an extra scene to show them, even if it's just short)
- Decide if I should add japanese voice acting (I always wanted to do this. But there are concerns that come with it)
- Check if soundeffects are well placed
- Order missing face expressions
- Order animated assets of characters that haven't been animated yet
- Test the game
- Add achievements
- Create a Trailer

Here are the assets that I currently have:
- BG: 9 (I need 1 more)
- CG: 40 (I need 1 or 2 more as of now)
- Chara: 15 (I need 1 more)
- Creature: 3
- Items: 23
- Maps: 2
- Music: 8 (6 more in the making)

And that's about it.
In general, I'm happy with the progress I was able to make lately. Time will tell, if it's going to be enough for a release in April. But I'm always optimistic.

Thank you for the read, and leave a comment if you like.
Take care everyone!
meta.baron

notes.title: Chapter 4: DevLog#2
notes.content:
Happy Holidays dear Rebels!

I hope you are all doing great and have a enjoyable time with the ones you love.

It has been a hot minute since my last update, I apologize.
I've had a lot of ups and downs throughout the year, but I'm still trying to progress with Chapter 4 as best as I can.
It's still a bit early to say whether I can keep the deadline (April), but it is what I'm aiming for.

The store page has been up for several months now. Please check it out in case you've missed it:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544280/Rebels__Under_the_Spell_of_Magic_Chapter_4/]Chapter 4 Store Page[/url]

As for the current new assets I have acquired so far:
- BG: 5
- CG: 31
- Chara: 7
- Creature: 1
- Items: 15
- Maps: 2
- Music: 8

The current CG amount is fairly healthy, which I am happy about. Sadly, the progress in writing was not as good and is behind in schedule.
I'm trying to keep progressing throughout the holidays and the upcoming months, so that I can hopefully release the game in April.

Something else that I always wanted to do, is to implement japanese voice lines, but I'm still debating if this is the right time to go for it. Of course, it also depends on the prices of the voice actor, and if I find suitable candidates for that task.

This is going to be it for now.
I hope everyone is looking forward to it, and as always, I am very grateful for all your support.
Take care everyone!
meta.baron

notes.title: Chapter 4: DevLog#1
notes.content:
Hello Rebels!

I hope you are all in good health!
Hopefully the released chapters have been enjoyable so far.

I have slowly and humbly been working on chapter 4.
So, don't worry, I'm steadily continuing this adventure, as it has always been a dream of mine.
However, I might not do as many update-posts as I did previously, unless you wish to have more regular info about the project. Just let me know. =)

I'm still using VNM, although it has given me several problems while working on the previous chapter. But I think this is the best and fastest way for me to continue.

Here's a rough outline of the content for the next chapter.
(green = done / blue = WIP)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213112/9c3d72a93f6458b39c76a07def8dda2ba29ac970.jpg[/img]

As for the new assets I have acquired so far:
- BG: 3
- CG: 7
- Chara: 4
- Creature: 1
- Items: 13
- Music: 6

It might also be interesting to note that I believe this to become the biggest chapter yet (gametime-wise). As far as the amount of CGs goes, I'm not sure if I'll be able to surpass that number, but we will see as we progress with the project.

I'm probably going to start the shop page for the next chapter soon, as I'm already able to create and publish some screenshots. If everything works out, that would be one issue less to worry about.

This will be all for now, but don't feel shy to make a post if you have something to share. =)

Take care everyone!
meta.baron

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
- Added an in-game choice to have animated character sprites enabled or disabled. This option is meant for low-end device users. The choice appears right after Cerek's flashback.
- fixed a bug where Hakurin's CG would wrongly show up in the morning when sleeping at the mansion. The CG should only be displayed if the player selected to spend time with her.
- fixed a bug with the anchor of Ismalyn's CG that would wrongly cause it to move out of the screen.
- fixed a bug where some players were not able to continue from the intermission right before the preparation for the Trial. The whole scene was re-created for it to work properly.

Should you have save slots for any of these scenes, loading them might crash the game. It is recommended to load from a previous save slot if that happens.

As always, if you have something to report or some sort of issue, feel free to contact me. I'll get back to you as soon as I can.
meta.baron
